title: The kb: hook blocks a good pack routed split by a word nowhere in the kb
goal: kb_hook.py lets every pack with a route through to the model with the differential, a good pack routed split by a word nowhere in the kb included (it decides on res['route'], not on unmatched and spread alone); TestKbHookRoute plants such a pack.

run: import subprocess,sys;o=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kb_hook.py','--test','kb: What is the default Windows LAPS password length for frobnicated devices?'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout;assert 'route: split' not in o or '"block"' not in o,o[:300]
